name: Keeyo
description: Self-hosted inventory for your hardware security keys — know which passkeys, 2FA registrations and TOTP codes live on which physical key.
longDescription:
It always starts with one security key. Then you buy a backup. Then you get another one for work. Keeyo gives every physical security key (YubiKey, Token2, …) a digital asset tag so you always know what lives on which piece of plastic.

  • Scan to detect — plug a key in, tap it, and Keeyo reads its fingerprint via WebAuthn and fills in vendor and model from the live FIDO device registry.
  • Track what goes where — every passkey, 2FA registration and TOTP per key, plus the reverse lookup per service.
  • Lost-key checklist — mark a key lost and get a revocation checklist of every service that still trusts it.
  • Identify a mystery key — found a random key in a drawer? One tap names it.
  • Tap-to-reveal secret notes — end-to-end encrypted on PRF-capable keys.
  • Sign-in 2FA — protect Keeyo itself with a hardware key or authenticator app, plus recovery codes.

Keeyo stores metadata only — no TOTP seeds, no private keys, no secrets ever leave your hardware keys. Since Cosmos serves apps over HTTPS, Keeyo's WebAuthn features work out of the box.
